title: Patterned Fills for ggplot2 and grid Graphics
text: fillpattern provides geometric patterns replace solid color fills statistical graphics. patterns ensure figures remain distinguishable viewed colorblind readers printed black white. Compared similar ggpattern package, fillpattern: dependencies beyond base R ggplot2. Works ggplot2::geom_* functions. Focuses simple geometric patterns.

title: Patterned Fills for ggplot2 and grid Graphics
text: Simply add scale_fill_pattern() ggplot.  Works geom_bar(), geom_boxplot(), geom_violin(), geom_* functions accept fill aesthetic.
code: library(ggplot2) #> Warning: package 'ggplot2' was built under R version 4.6.2 library(fillpattern)  ggplot(mpg, aes(x = class, color = drv, fill = drv)) +   geom_bar() +   scale_fill_pattern()

title: Patterned Fills for Grobs — fill_pattern
text: patterns, pattern pattern specification. Options "brick", "chevron", "fish", "grid", "herringbone", "hexagon", "octagon", "rain", "saw", "shingle", "rshingle", "stripe", "wave", "empty", optionally abbreviated /suffixed modifiers. See "Pattern Names" section . Default: "brick" fg Foreground color, pattern's lines, NA use outline color (col) shape filled. Default: "black" bg Background color, grid pattern (grid::linearGradient() another fill_pattern()), grob, NA use outline color (col) shape filled. Default: "transparent" angle much rotate pattern, given degrees clockwise. Default: 0 width width pattern tile. Assumed millimeters unless set otherwise unit(). Default: 5 height height pattern tile, NA match width. Assumed millimeters unless set otherwise unit(). Default: NA lwd Line width. positive number, 0 lines. See graphics::par() additional details. Default: 1 lty Line type. One "solid", "dashed", "dotted", "dotdash", "longdash", "twodash", "blank"; integer 0 6; string 2, 4, 6, 8 hex digits, "44" "1342". See graphics::par() additional details. Default: "solid" fun function modifying graphical parameters immediately rendering. accept two parameters: env, environment function modify, row, row transformed data ggbuild constructed grob (including aes mappings). function return gTree error force returning parent function immediately, NULL continue processing updated env. Default: NULL min_size Minimum size pattern draw. Applies width height. Useful avoiding CPU memory overhead tiny graphical elements. Shapes narrower shorter min_size filled solid fg color instead. Assumed millimeters unless set otherwise unit(). Default: 2

Except patterns fun, can also function takes n = length(patterns) returns values use, color palette like bg = hcl.colors. Invalid values give warning pattern created, replaced default parameter. invalid pattern name, invalid parts replaced dropped: "stripes45_lg" becomes "brick45_lg", "fish_huge" becomes "fish". pattern still drawn, filled solid fg color instead, warning shown per session. fg bg NA, color looked pattern drawn: col shape pattern fills, "black" (fg) / "white" (bg) shape single, visible col. grob draws several shapes, rectGrob(x = 1:3/4, ...), qualifies col.

title: Patterned Fills for Grobs — fill_pattern
text: Base name: Pattern names must always begin one "brick", "chevron", "fish", "grid", "herringbone", "hexagon", "octagon", "rain", "saw", "shingle", "rshingle", "stripe", "wave", "empty". also available fill_pattern_names. "empty" draws pattern lines, bg color. useful baseline control group shown next patterned groups. Modifiers accepted visible effect. names support partial matching, e.g. "", "herring", "herringbone" valid. However, tiling designs may added future, recommended use full names finished code. Angle modifier: number immediately following tiling design, "stripe45", "fish180", "saw20". added angle argument; fill_pattern("brick45", angle=45) equivalent fill_pattern("brick90"). Width height modifier: underscore followed single size used width height. , underscore followed new width height separated colon. Can absolute sizes ("grid_4" "hex_5mm:0.1npc") relative width height arguments ("saw_sm" "brick_*2:/2"). shorthand values "xs", "sm", "md", "lg", "xl" equivalent "/4", "/2", "1", "*2", "*4", respectively. Line width style: underscore, followed number, followed one "solid", "dashed", "dotted", "dotdash", "longdash", "twodash". example, "shingle_0.5dashed" "wave_2solid". number component optional, "oct_longdash" also valid, use lwd line width. specify just line width, suffix number "lwd": "grid_2lwd" use lty line style. "_0lwd" draws lines. Combinations: Modifiers can combined order. example, "hex_lg:xl_2dotted" "grid45_dashed_1.4lwd_:6mm_sm:".

title: Patterned Fills for Grobs — fill_pattern
code: library(grid)     library(fillpattern)          grid.newpage()     grid.rect(gp = gpar(fill = fill_pattern("brick", bg = "gray", angle = 90)))           grid.newpage()     gp <- Map(gpar, fill = fill_pattern(       patterns = c("grid_3lwd", "stripe_longdash", "herringbone45", "hexagon_lg"),       fg       = c("black",     "white",           "black",         "blue"),       bg       = c("white",     "black",           "cyan",          "beige") ))     grid.circle( gp = gp[[1]], x = 1/4, y = 3/4, r = 1/5)     grid.polygon(gp = gp[[2]], x = c(9,12,15)/16, y = c(15,9,15)/16)     grid.rect(   gp = gp[[3]], x = 1/4, y = 1/4, width = 2/5, height = 2/5)     grid.rect(   gp = gp[[4]], x = 3/4, y = 1/4, width = 2/5, height = 2/5)           # fg = NA picks up the outline color of each shape.     grid.newpage()     fill <- fill_pattern("stripe45", fg = NA)     grid.circle(x = 1/4, r = 1/5, gp = gpar(col = "red",  fill = fill))     grid.circle(x = 3/4, r = 1/5, gp = gpar(col = "blue", fill = fill))           # A color palette function is called with the number of patterns.     grid.newpage()     fills <- fill_pattern(c("brick", "fish", "grid"), fg = "white", bg = hcl.colors)     for (i in 1:3)       grid.rect(x = (i - 0.5) / 3, width = 0.3, gp = gpar(fill = fills[[i]]))

title: Pattern Names — fill_pattern_names

title: Pattern Names — fill_pattern_names
code: library(grid)     library(fillpattern)      fill_pattern_names #>  [1] "brick"       "chevron"     "fish"        "grid"        "herringbone" #>  [6] "hexagon"     "octagon"     "rain"        "saw"         "shingle"     #> [11] "rshingle"    "stripe"      "wave"        "empty"           head(fill_pattern_order) #> [1] "brick"     "fish"      "stripe45"  "hexagon"   "shingle45" "wave135"        # These are equivalent.     fill <- fill_pattern(3)     fill <- fill_pattern(fill_pattern_order[3])      # One rectangle per base pattern.     grid.newpage()     fills <- fill_pattern(fill_pattern_names, bg = "white")     for (i in seq_along(fills))       grid.rect(         x      = ((i - 1) %% 5 + 0.5) / 5,         y      = 1 - ((i - 1) %/% 5 + 0.5) / 3,         width  = 0.18,         height = 0.28,         gp     = gpar(fill = fills[[i]]) )

title: fillpattern (development version)
text: Pattern Name Lists: fill_pattern_names lists 14 base pattern names, fill_pattern_order lists 35 patterns numbers (default scale_fill_pattern(patterns = seq_len)) map (trevorld/gridpattern#141). Palette Function: New pal_fill_pattern() returns palette scale_fill_pattern() uses, theme(palette.fill.discrete = ) ggplot2 4.0 later, packages’ scales (trevorld/gridpattern#141). Color Palette Functions: fill_pattern() now accepts function argument except patterns fun, called number patterns, like scale_fill_pattern() already . color palette bg = hcl.colors gives pattern color. Lines: lwd = 0, "_0lwd" pattern modifier, now draws pattern lines (trevorld/gridpattern#141). Line Types: lty accepts every line type ?par : six names, "blank", integers 0 6, hex dash patterns "44" "1342" (#11).

title: fillpattern (development version)
text: Palette Functions Scale: scale_fill_pattern(fg = <function>) longer warns “.na() applied non-(list vector) type ‘closure’”. bg fade defaults now NULL, worked fg evaluated, results . Invalid Arguments: Invalid arguments, misspelled pattern name unsupported lty, longer silently draw solid block. now give warning pattern created replaced default argument; invalid pattern name keeps valid parts, "stripes45" becomes "brick45". fillPatternGrob() uses first value longer argument, warning, instead error. Shapes smaller min_size still filled solid fg color, without warning, now use shape’s outline color fg = NA. failure draw pattern warns per session (#11). Pattern Grob Backgrounds: bg can now grid pattern, grid::linearGradient() another fill_pattern(), passed directly list, e.g. bg = list(grad, "cyan"). Previously, fill_pattern() scale_fill_pattern() split pattern components quietly drew wrong colors, fillPatternGrob() errored. grob bg now drawn -instead replaced solid fg-colored rectangle (#10).

title: fillpattern (development version)

title: fillpattern 1.0.5

Transparent Colors: fully transparent colour (e.g.  ‘ggalluvial’’s default) now treated missing, patterns stay visible.
